description: Read-only album hygiene over your liked tracks: flags near-complete albums worth saving and lone singles with nothing else liked from their artist (low confidence). Album totals come from the /me/tracks walk; a width-bounded per-id GET /albums/{id} fills in the rest. Never mutates. dry_run previews cost.

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: library_hygiene
